messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy complete to prod (us-west2 + eu1) — service=inference-runtime image=inference-runtime:v2.3.1; postdeploy smoke started; release notes https://go.redwood/release/2.3.1 :rocket:

anya: seeing spike in eu1 synth p95 (~850ms -> 1.6s) and a few 503s on /embed-route
mike: confirm 3x 503 in last 2m, logs show backend worker eviction symptoms on node eu1-rt-3
sre-julio: can we pin traffic back to v2.3.0 for eu1? prefer quick pin > full rollback
release-manager: agree with pin if it's just eu1; what's the command? also will annotate release notes
olivia: ran quick smoke: `curl -s -D - https://eu1.api.redwood/infer -H "x-route: embed" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` -> 503
olivia: pasted last headers and small trace: `X-Request-Id: req_abc123` (sharing logs in thread)
observability-bot: [alert] eu1:synthetic-embed failed 3/5 checks, p95 latency 1.6s, error_rate 0.6% :warning:

anya: if we pin, do a 10-minute monitor then re-open traffic. can we route 100% eu1 to v2.3.0?
mike: runbook snippet: `rbacctl set-route-weight inference-runtime eu1 v2.3.0 100` — this will set immediate weight to previous version
sre-julio: I'll run the command and watch. tagging @olivia and @release-manager
sre-julio: ran `rbacctl set-route-weight inference-runtime eu1 v2.3.0 100` — changed, samples show successful responses now
olivia: smoke after pin: 200 OK, latency ~420ms p95 on embed
release-manager: noting change in release notes: "pin eu1 to v2.3.0 after post-deploy synthetic failures; investigating OOM behavior on v2.3.1"
anya: will open a tracking issue for heap growth and add repro with req_abc123
mike: +1. Recommend follow-up patch to reduce bundle size and re-run canary in 24h
deploy-bot: Route weight update noted. Marking deploy as partial-pin in release metadata. :white_check_mark:
